note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row moved to {gap} under the owner ruling that RTR version 0 is owed. RFC 6810 Section 5.1 reads 'Max Length:  An 8-bit unsigned integer denoting the longest prefix allowed by the prefix.  This MUST NOT be less than the Prefix Length element.' and Section 5 defines the Protocol Version as 'An eight-bit unsigned integer, currently 0, denoting the version of this protocol.' The obligation is on a version 0 Prefix PDU, and Ze never processes one: internal/component/bgp/plugins/rpki/rtr_session.go::RTRSession.handlePDU returns errRtrUnsupportedProtocol for every PDU but a Serial Notify or Error Report whose version is below rtrVersionMin = 1, refuses a cache's Error Report code 4 that offers a version below rtrVersionMin, and RTRSession.syncOnce bounds the downgrade loop at rtrVersionMin. parsePrefixPDU does refuse a Max Length below the Prefix Length, but only in version 1 and 2 sessions; that proof is RFC8210-5.1-2's, and the earlier enforced verdict rested on version 1 tests that no longer carry this id. No version 0 path exists, so the requirement is unmet.
